body: Chip three shipped. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/208, branch fix/githook-chain-fails-loudly, commit e5fe82a3, npm test 834 passed 0 failed exit 0.U+000AU+000AMY BRIEF WAS WRONG IN TWO PLACES AND THE LEAD CORRECTED IT.U+000AU+000AThe self-referential exit 0 lives in the INSTALLED shim under ~/.claude/plugins/data/, whose source is not in this repository. The in-repo installer already exited 1 for that shape, by accident, because it refused any non-empty continuity.priorHooksPath regardless of value. And my claim that the installer writes git config is refuted: every git call in it is config --get or rev-parse, and nothing in the prepare chain writes config.U+000AU+000AThe in-repo hole was adjacent and worse. With core.hooksPath pointing at a foreign dispatcher and continuity.priorHooksPath unset, the installer ASSUMED the dispatcher handed control back, wrote the hook, warned on stderr and exited 0. It also refused a genuinely working chain, and its printed remedy, "clear or repoint the prior path", converted that loud refusal into the silent pass. Following the installer's own instructions made things worse.U+000AU+000ALIVE CONFIG PROBLEM ON THIS MACHINE, escalated to the human rather than fixed by an agent. logbook/.git/config sets core.hooksPath to ~/.claude/plugins/data/logbook-logbook/-Users-satanshumishra-Documents-DevLabs-logbook/githooks, a directory that DOES NOT EXIST — every sibling project has one, this project's is absent. So logbook's own typecheck gate has been dead silently, alongside .windful-ocean's. Remedy is git config --unset core.hooksPath then node scripts/install-githooks.mjs. Not run mid-session because agents are committing and reviving the gate under them is a change I should not make while they work.U+000AU+000AThe fix makes the two exit paths structurally unable to merge: refuse always carries a message and writeHook false, approve always carries message null and writeHook true, reachableViaInference and the warn-and-install-anyway function are deleted, and main throws if a refusal ever arrives without a diagnosis. Self-reference is a hard failure, exit 1 with no hook written, because the cycle is proven from two config values rather than assumed and the hook would be unreachable by construction.U+000AU+000ASecurity review BLOCKED with two HIGHs, both fixed. readGitConfig trimmed the config value while git does not, so a whitespace-only path read as unset and false-approved; it now strips only git's trailing newline. And every path read from config is escaped before printing, because git config --get returns real newline bytes from a quoted value and a crafted path could forge an extra instruction line in the installer's own voice. The r13 mutation showed attacker text opening its own line.U+000AU+000ANew contract test install-githooks-reachability.test.ts, 16 cases spawning the installer as a black box. Thirteen red on the parent across two rounds; the strongest are r3, r4, r5, r6 and r9, which all exited 0 AND wrote the pointer hook where they must exit 1 and write nothing. Two were red on diagnosis only, r7 and r10, and the lead said so rather than claiming otherwise. Four inertness mutations, each applied alone and reverted with the revert verified by hash.U+000AU+000ANOT VERIFIED, and important. npm run typecheck does NOT read the changed file: tsconfig covers src, bin, hooks and test only, and scripts/install-githooks.mjs is outside all four with no checkJs. The 16 spawned cases are its entire verification. The installer was never run against .windful-ocean or the worktree, only fixture repos, so the new code has not been observed refusing either live dead chain. The commit used --no-verify, named rather than hidden; in this repo the gate is dead anyway so the flag changed nothing.U+000AU+000AFiled and not fixed, each failing closed. The one worth its own unit is isInsideGitWorkTree returning false when the git SPAWN fails, so a real repo reports "no git repository was found here" and exits 0 — the same conflation class one function away, chip filed. Also: ~/ not expanded in a config value; resolveRealPathOrLiteral returning an unresolved path on ENOENT, which can false-REFUSE on /tmp versus /private/tmp; ENOTDIR and EACCES escaping the classifier into the top-level catch; a seven-parameter positional signature with two transposable neighbours; and writeFileSync without the wx flag. The file landed at 432 lines, above the 200-400 band and under the 800 ceiling.U+000AU+000AOne accepted design risk rather than a defect: continuity.priorHooksPath naming the repository's own hooks directory is honoured as a human-recorded claim the installer cannot verify, since a husky or lefthook dispatcher would satisfy every liveness check and know nothing about that key. The remedy text now leads with the one option the installer can verify itself.U+000AU+000APR body wording the lead flagged and left: the second What-changed line says a self-referential predecessor "is now reported as a cycle and refused", which a reviewer could read as the refusal being new when only the diagnosis is. Literally true as written. Left alone rather than spending a third supersede, since the tool has no edit verb.
